dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Highly visible, thick white horizontal band across the coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark plumage base.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, prominent white boundaries along the edges of the folded flight feathers, creating a distinct high-contrast striped appearance.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A narrow, high-contrast black curvilinear band forming a collar-like shape on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct boundary defined by the black collar line separating the blue-grey crown from the greyish mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced raised sagittal crest on the crown and a high-contrast black ocular stripe/facial marking pattern.
